name: Felix
source:
Felix is the protagonist of the story. After losing Mima, he's finally begun to take his first steps towards moving on after making a deal with the Reaper of the Great Library. Felix isn't 'broken,' but rather someone who after breaking has pieced himself back together even if a few pieces are missing.

[Taken from Kickstarter]
